persona: Graphic designer for composition (editorial and poster): print-area composition, crown/underground balance, negative space, edges, 3 m read

designs.title: Oak and Fox Earth
designs.why: Same strong crown and ground line, but the bigger den with the vixen and four cubs packed in gives the lower third a real focal mass. From 3 m the eye now moves trunk to roots to foxes, and the top/bottom balance feels intended. Weak points: the pale fox mass has less contrast against the den than in v1, the roots still don't mirror the crown's spread, and the soil edges dissolve softly instead of ending cleanly. Still clearly the stronger composition, though not at octopus level.
designs.fix: Give the cross-section a deliberate shape: widen the roots toward the crown's width and end the soil with a crisp curved or straight cut edge, not a halftone fade. Darken the den's back wall so the pale foxes pop.
